description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Application Operations professional to provide hands-on ownership of Oracle Order and Service Management (OSM), Oracle Unified Inventory Management (UIM), and associated telecom fulfilment services. Based in Pune, this role is focused on ensuring service stability, SLA/KPI achievement, technical troubleshooting, order fulfilment continuity, inventory integrity, operational governance, automation, and continual service improvement. The role also supports the adoption of AI/AIOps capabilities to enhance observability, incident management, anomaly detection, knowledge reuse, and operational efficiency.

**What you will do**
--------------------

Oracle OSM/UIM Technical Operations  

* Provide hands-on operational support for Oracle OSM and UIM environments covering order orchestration, workflow execution, service fulfilment, inventory allocation, and service/resource lifecycle activities.
* Troubleshoot stuck or failed orders, orchestration exceptions, provisioning failures, inventory inconsistencies, and integration issues using application logs, SQL, Unix/Linux diagnostics, and operational tools.
* Analyse OSM order states, workflows, tasks, and fallout trends and coordinate approved recovery actions.
* Investigate inventory allocation, reservation, reconciliation, and data integrity issues impacting service activation and fulfilment.
* Maintain operational knowledge of WebLogic-hosted OSM/UIM services and related dependencies.

SLA, Incident, Problem and Service Reliability  

* Ensure compliance with agreed service levels and operational KPIs.
* Lead technical triage and restoration activities during major incidents affecting OSM/UIM services.
* Conduct structured root cause analysis and problem management activities to reduce recurring issues and improve service reliability.
* Monitor application performance, fulfilment flows, transaction processing, inventory exceptions, and integration health.
* Support operational readiness activities, service recovery validation, and post-change health assessments.

Automation, AI/AIOps and Continual Improvement  

* Automate operational activities including health checks, diagnostics, reporting, reconciliation, log analysis, and housekeeping tasks.
* Identify opportunities to automate safe and repeatable order recovery and reprocessing activities through approved controls.
* Improve monitoring effectiveness, alert quality, fault isolation, supportability, availability, and operational efficiency through observability insights.
* Contribute to AI/AIOps initiatives including anomaly detection, event correlation, incident summarisation, knowledge recommendations, and assisted order remediation.
* Maintain high-quality operational data to support continual improvement and AI-enabled operational outcomes.
* Drive measurable service improvement initiatives and track delivery through operational reviews.

Operational Governance and Stakeholder Coordination  

* Participate in service reviews covering operational performance, incidents, risks, capacity, monitoring, and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, SOPs, known-error records, and support knowledge repositories.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, middleware, database, provisioning, networking, service management, and vendor teams.
* Support capability development through mentoring on OSM/UIM troubleshooting, monitoring, inventory diagnostics, and automation practices.
* Ensure compliance with approved change, security, audit, access, and governance requirements.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Extensive experience in telecom OSS and Application Operations environments with strong exposure to Oracle OSM and/or Oracle UIM.
* Hands-on experience managing order orchestration, order fallout, service fulfilment, provisioning, and inventory management issues within production environments.
* Strong working knowledge of Oracle OSM order lifecycle, workflows, decomposition, recovery, and exception handling.
* Strong operational understanding of UIM inventory allocation, reservation, reconciliation, and inventory integrity processes.
* Experience supporting Oracle WebLogic environments relevant to OSM/UIM operations.
* Good hands-on expertise in Unix/Linux, Shell scripting, Oracle SQL, and PL/SQL for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Experience analysing application logs and performing end-to-end troubleshooting across application, middleware, database, and interface layers.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or Zabbix.
* Understanding of AI/AIOps concepts and the application of AI-assisted operational capabilities within controlled production environments.
* Experience in Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management within ITIL-based operations.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams, service stakeholders, and external suppliers.
* Proven experience delivering operational improvements, automation initiatives, RCA activities, and SLA/KPI performance outcomes.

**Not a perfect fit**
---------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work on business-critical telecom fulfilment and inventory management platforms.
* Exposure to large-scale Oracle OSM and UIM production environments within a global telecommunications organisation.
* Involvement in major incident management, service reliability improvements, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to contribute to automation, observability, and AI/AIOps adoption programmes.
* Collaboration with cross-functional technology, operations, and vendor teams.
* Ability to influence service quality, operational efficiency, and continual improvement outcomes.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced Oracle OSM and UIM operational support and troubleshooting techniques.
* Telecom fulfilment, provisioning, inventory management, and orchestration processes.
* Service reliability engineering principles and operational resilience practices.
* Automation development using Shell scripting, SQL, and PL/SQL.
* Monitoring, observability, event correlation, and proactive operational management.
* AI/AIOps applications for anomaly detection, operational intelligence, and service optimisation.
* Incident leadership, structured problem management, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Cross-functional stakeholder management and operational governance practices.

description:
**Company Description**  

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a **Support AI Operations Manager** to drive and coordinate the growing portfolio of AI initiatives across QAD Support. This role will provide dedicated ownership for ensuring AI opportunities are identified, prioritized, coordinated across teams, and successfully moved from concept and pilot through implementation, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.


The ideal candidate combines strong project and program management skills with a practical understanding of AI technologies and delivery models. This person will serve as a bridge between Support and technical teams, bringing structure, governance, and accountability to AI initiatives without being responsible for hands\-on AI development.


This is an individual contributor role that will work closely with Support leadership and cross\-functional partners across Engineering, Product, IT, Data, Security, and other relevant teams.

**Key Deliverables:**

**AI Strategy, Roadmap \& Governance**

* Own and maintain the Support AI roadmap, ensuring initiatives are aligned with Support priorities and broader QAD AI strategy.
* Establish and maintain governance processes to evaluate, prioritize, and manage AI opportunities across Support.
* Create consistent operating mechanisms for AI initiative reviews, status reporting, decision\-making, and leadership visibility.
* Track the overall portfolio of AI initiatives, including milestones, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and expected business outcomes.

**AI Project \& Program Management**

* Manage AI use cases from initial intake and evaluation through prioritization, pilot, implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Coordinate cross\-functional AI projects across Support, Engineering, Product, IT, Data, Security, and other stakeholders.
* Develop project plans, establish milestones and owners, identify dependencies, and proactively remove roadblocks.
* Partner with technical teams and external vendors as needed to ensure initiatives are delivered effectively and in accordance with business requirements.
* Ensure AI initiatives have clear success criteria and measurable outcomes, including productivity improvements, cost savings, customer experience improvements, and impact on key Support metrics.

**AI Adoption \& Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI tools and capabilities across Support by partnering with leaders and teams to integrate AI into existing workflows and processes.
* Identify and address barriers to adoption, including process, technology, training, and change\-management needs.
* Coordinate communications, training, documentation, and enablement activities to support successful implementation.
* Monitor adoption and effectiveness following implementation and identify opportunities for continued improvement.

**Opportunity Identification \& Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Support leaders and subject matter experts to identify opportunities where AI can improve operational performance and the customer experience.
* Evaluate potential use cases across areas such as Support productivity, case diagnostics, knowledge management, case resolution, customer self\-service, and mean time to resolution (MTTR).
* Help assess the feasibility, potential value, risks, and organizational readiness of proposed AI use cases.
* Maintain awareness of emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to apply new technologies to Support operations.

* Partner with technical, security, legal, and data governance teams to ensure AI initiatives comply with QAD's AI, security, privacy, and data governance requirements.
* Ensure appropriate governance and risk considerations are incorporated throughout the AI project lifecycle.
* Help establish repeatable processes for evaluating and managing AI\-related risks within Support.

**Experience:**

* Overall 8\-10\+ years working within support with 2–3\+ years of hands\-on experience managing AI initiatives, AI projects, or AI\-enabled business transformation programs.
* Additional experience in project management, program management, operations, or business transformation.

**Technical Skills:**

* Practical understanding of AI technologies, use cases, implementation approaches, and AI delivery models; hands\-on AI development experience is not required.

**Soft Skills:**

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple cross\-functional initiatives simultaneously and drive projects from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to establish structure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accountability across stakeholders.

Beyond the competitive benefits and compensation, Kohler proudly offers a rich culture, steeped in creativity and commitment to our associates and communities. We invite you to learn more about our culture and company at www.kohlercompany.com

**Kohler India is certified as a Great Place to Work Organization. This certification is an endorsement of the culture and values we live by \- every day.**

  

**Position Description**


**Position Title**

  

AM – Customer Care

  

  

**Department**

  

Customer Services

  

  

**Division**

  

Kohler India Technical Center, Pune

  

  

**Grade**

  

AM

  

  

**Reporting to**

Manager – Customer Care

  

  

**About the position:**

We (Kohler India Technical Center) are a captive global center providing technical and nontechnical support for all the businesses and product lines for Kohler India (Kitchen and Bath).


As a Customer Care Assistant Manager at Kohler, you will be responsible for managing the daily operations of our Customer Care department. You will oversee a team of customer care associates, ensuring that they provide excellent service to our end consumers. In this role, you will be responsible for setting goals and metrics, monitoring performance, and implementing strategies to improve customer experience. You will also work closely with other departments to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.


**Role and Responsibility:**


**Be a Brand Ambassador for our customers by building relationships and creating loyalty**. Provide world\-class first level inbound phone/chat/email support for customers by troubleshooting, investigating, and resolving customers' inquiries about Kohler India products with the goal of resolving each issue on the first contact. You will be expected to provide empathetic, courteous, quality customer service in an accurate and timely manner in accordance with Kohler protocols while maintaining a positive, problem\-solving approach.

  

* Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Customer Care department.
* Hire, train, and supervise a team of customer service associates.
* Set performance goals and metrics for the team and monitor progress.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve customer experience.
* Maintain and improve customer service level agreements and procedures.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and provide regular reports to senior management.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth operations and effective communication.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customers.
* Provide coaching and feedback to team members to improve their performance and development.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, as well as applicable regulations and laws.

**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree mandatory – master’s degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in customer service or related field, with at least 5 years in a people management role.
* Strong leadership, Problem solving and People management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategies.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and customer service software.
* Experience working in the manufacturing industry is preferred.
  

This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. Employees may be required to perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.


**Working Conditions:**


This is a full\-time role based in our customer service Pune office. The includes evenings and weekends working to meet customer demands, as we operate 24/7\. You'll work six days a week with rotating shifts and weekly offs. Occasional travel for business may also be required.


**Organizational Relationships:**

* Reports to Manager – Customer Care,
* Regular interactions with business stakeholders from different Kohler business verticals at ITC
* Frequent interaction with internal stakeholders including senior leadership team.

Team Management, Escalation Management, People Leadership, Inbound Voice Process, Data Analytics, Reports and Dashboards
